scientific_integrity: Original counts are exact signed integer sums; 1716 orbit records exhaust 2^24 frequencies through a proved group-symmetry partition, with independent partial direct-sum cross-checks. Published unsigned results are credited; scientific historical priority is bounded and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact 29-level census pertains to labelled balanced 4-by-6 tables. The eight-type orbit-compression algorithm applies to 4-by-2n tables of every positive width parameter, but there is no claimed closed all-width spectrum or uniform nonvanishing theorem.
title: Eight-column-type Walsh compression and the complete spectrum of balanced \(4\times6\) tables
